import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Sales by Product and Size (Bar plot)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
product_size_sales = df.groupby(['product', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack().fillna(0)
product_size_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product and Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='Size')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales Trend Over Time (Line plot)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('datetime')
ax2.plot(df_sorted['datetime'], df_sorted['total'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
ax2.set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Time', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sale Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sales Distribution by Age Group (Pie chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
age_group_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(age_group_sales)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(age_group_sales, labels=age_group_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   colors=colors, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Payment Method Analysis (Bar plot)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
payment_sales = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum()
bars = ax4.bar(payment_sales.index, payment_sales.values, color=['skyblue', 'lightcoral'], edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_title('Total Sales by Payment Method', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# Add summary statistics as text
summary_text = f"""
Dataset Summary:
• Total Transactions: {len(df)}
• Total Revenue: ${df['total'].sum():.2f}
• Average Transaction: ${df['total'].mean():.2f}
• Unique Products: {df['product'].nunique()}
• Time Range: {df['datetime'].min().strftime('%H:%M')} to {df['datetime'].max().strftime('%H:%M')}
"""

fig.text(0.02, 0.02, summary_text, fontsize=10, verticalalignment='bottom',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis - January 1, 2024', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.96])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
